partners.mechanism_chain: ATP8B1 (HGNC:958) —DISRUPTS→ phospholipid transport (GO:0006801); phospholipid transport (GO:0006801) —LEADS_TO→ Cholestasis (HP:0001384); ATP2A2 (HGNC:957) —DISRUPTS→ calcium homeostasis (GO:0005488); calcium homeostasis (GO:0005488) —LEADS_TO→ Palmoplantar keratosis (HP:0008951); calcium homeostasis (GO:0005488) —LEADS_TO→ Cutaneous dyskeratosis (HP:0008950). Loss-of-function in ATP8B1 disrupts phospholipid transport, leading to cholestasis in PFIC1. Concurrently, loss-of-function in ATP2A2 disrupts calcium homeostasis, leading to palmoplantar keratosis and cutaneous dyskeratosis in Darier disease.
